assertions.subject: Seizure disorder
assertions.quote: a type of non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema termed neurogenic pulmonary edema (NPE) can arise after severe or ongoing seizure activity

assertions.subject: Seizure disorder
assertions.quote: The increase in intracranial pressure during a seizure leads to a surge in catecholamines

assertions.subject: Neurogenic pulmonary edema
assertions.quote: A bilaterally symmetric interstitial-to-alveolar pattern most prominent in the caudodorsal lung fields is commonly seen

assertions.subject: Neurogenic pulmonary edema
assertions.quote: the use of diuretics such as furosemide is controversial and may not be recommended as a first-line treatment with NPE

assertions.subject: Neurogenic pulmonary edema
assertions.quote: Treatment relies on supplemental oxygen as needed

assertions.subject: Seizure disorder
assertions.quote: thoracic radiographs may also be used to rule out evidence of aspiration pneumonia/pneumonitis
